I01.description: Foundation: real-PostgreSQL harness, role separation, synthetic keys, service skeleton and the aggregate gate. No product acceptance case is required yet; all 44 remain NOT_RUN.

I02.description: Contracts: strict JSON, payload validation, RFC 8785 digests, SM-JWS-ES256-1, Go/TypeScript golden vectors, closed OpenAPI and the PostgreSQL locking prototype. Contract and prototype checks only; no acceptance case becomes PASS here.

required_tests.test: verifier.test.ts/trust store rejects unknown fields such as a remote key URL

I03-I06.description: Core transactions: identity mapping, mandates, trusted instructions, amendments, reservations, signed permits, admission, cleanup, recovery, outbox and crash/race behaviour through the real API and PostgreSQL. Case mappings stay complete=false until QA reproduces them independently.

required_tests.test: verifier.test.ts/trust store rejects unknown fields such as a remote key URL

I07.description: Evidence: read-only observer, signed execution and observation records, evidence export and reconcile, and the standalone TypeScript verifier and CLI. Case mappings stay complete=false until QA reproduces them.

r1-engine.description: Active R1 engine gate: all full-R0 requirements plus dispatch, recovery-anchor admission fencing, crash-safe repair, signed R1 evidence and independent readback. Integration uses real PostgreSQL with the stub destination. The required GitHub job also runs TestR1OdooEndToEnd against real Odoo and checks the exact public-source export. T17–T19 (exact-action human approval, R1 decision 9) are mapped to the engine approval tests. T33–T35 are mapped to the engine tests against the stub and real PostgreSQL; the real-Odoo T33–T35 suite runs as a separate required CI step. A PASS here is developer evidence; SDET acceptance is recorded separately.
